metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a BioSemi ActiveTwo system with 64 Ag-AgCl electrodes positioned according to the extended 10-20 (10-10) system, plus 4 auxiliary oculogram channels, at a sampling rate of 2048 Hz. Each participant underwent a resting-state recording (4 minutes eyes closed, 4 minutes eyes open) followed by an LDAEP paradigm (1000 Hz tones at 55, 65, 75, 85, and 95 dB SPL; 80 trials per level). Raw data are unfiltered except for a standard anti-aliasing filter, and were stored in BrainVision format.
